items.summary: Vehicle plunges 900 metres off a hillside in Bungal Municipality; 13-year-old boy survives unharmed as police detain driver.

items.title: Bhutanese rights groups urge Shah to raise refugee issue with India
items.summary: They want the prime minister to press Narendra Modi to help resolve the decades-old refugee crisis, secure the release of political prisoners and address human rights violations in Bhutan.

items.title: Nepal’s ambassadors to India, China and Israel take oath
items.summary: The three were among ten ambassadorial nominees approved by the Parliamentary Hearing Committee after the Cabinet recommended 13 appointments in September.

items.title: Deleted from India’s voter rolls, some Muslims face detention, deportation
items.summary: A voter-roll revision has become entangled with a wider crackdown on suspected undocumented migrants.

items.title: Night travel restricted on Hetauda-Kathmandu road via Bhimphedi
items.summary: The move follows a fatal crash that killed 14 people last week, with authorities citing the narrow, winding and poorly lit road as a major accident risk.

items.title: Six wild elephants die in two months, raising conservation concerns
items.summary: From Chitwan to eastern Nepal, a series of elephant deaths has alarmed conservationists, who warn that shrinking habitats, human activities and unsafe migration routes could threaten the country’s wild elephant population.

items.title: Chhath concludes with offerings to rising sun
items.summary: Devotees gather on the banks of the Bagmati river in Thapathali, Kathmandu, to perform the final rituals of the four-day festival and pray for their families’ well-being.

items.title: UML puts local, provincial elections at centre of national gathering
items.summary: The party plans to mobilise its organisation for the upcoming polls while stepping up public outreach, defending democratic institutions and reshaping its political agenda.

items.title: Qatar’s economic slump puts Nepali workers’ jobs at risk
items.summary: New labour approvals for Qatar have fallen by 35 percent since the war began, while rising complaints of layoffs and delayed wages point to growing pressure on Nepali workers already employed there.

items.title: Law students challenge use of AI detectors to brand academic work as plagiarism
items.summary: A writ petition argues that AI use and plagiarism must be treated as distinct issues, warning that decisions based solely on AI-detection software could unfairly damage students’ academic careers.

items.title: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left the company in August 2025
items.summary: The Singapore-based Nvidia partner is under US scrutiny over allegations that it helped Chinese customers obtain chips restricted under Washington’s export controls.

items.title: Nepal’s stolen Uma-Maheshvara statues belong back in their shrines
items.summary: Returning stolen statues to the country is only the first step. They should be in the shrines where generations worshipped them.

items.title: Things to do in Kathmandu Valley this week
items.summary: From creative workshops and writing circles to European cinema and cricket, Kathmandu Valley has plenty to offer this week.

items.title: Nepal, India to launch Ayodhya-Janakpur train service during PM Shah’s visit
items.summary: The weekly service will initially run on an Indian train. Kathmandu is also preparing to seek New Delhi’s grant assistance to electrify the 28-kilometre stretch of railway in Nepal.

items.title: Dalit devotees face caste segregation at Chhath celebration in Madhesh
items.summary: Separate ghats and tents in Saptari and Rautahat expose the gap between the festival’s message of equality and the discrimination that persists despite constitutional guarantees and laws against caste-based discrimination.

items.title: Why did Nepal’s mountain agenda stall at COP31? A delegation insider explains
items.summary: Environment Minister’s adviser says the real contest at COP31 is now over the wording of the cover decision.

items.title: Rs43,500 is new minimum monthly wage for public project workers, twice the private-sector rate
items.summary: A new public procurement guideline guarantees higher pay and social security contributions for workers employed in government-funded projects, but contractors and labour suppliers say the rule came without consultation or cost analysis.

items.title: Attorney general’s office claims flaws in court verdicts on 33.5 kg gold smuggling case
items.summary: The attorney general’s office argues that the courts focused on the murder of Sanam Shakya but failed to examine the alleged smuggling network, organised crime and customs offences.

items.title: Why reforming business climate is vital to keeping youths home
items.summary: Many young people have pinned their hopes on this government; it cannot afford to disappoint them.

items.title: Why drying Madhesh is a disaster in the making
items.summary: Climate change is triggering multiple disasters simultaneously across the country, yet some remain far less visible than others.

items.title: Kathmandu to face Chitwan in NPL Eliminator after loss to Pokhara
items.summary: Kathmandu finish third with a 55-run defeat, while Kushal Bhurtel misses a century by one run as Pokhara post a record 224.
